display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (Supine): (Apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with no oxygen desaturation used and with or without arousal) / hour of sleep in supine position from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in supine body position (>= 0% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hrembp + hnrbp + carbp + canbp + oarbp + oanbp + marbp + manrbp)/(remepbp+nremepbp)
